## What it is

The disc that drops into the four top slots. Outside Ø96, hole Ø80, 2.4 mm thick. Printed with the tabs up. Turn it over so the tabs point down.

## Design notes

- The rim is the 48 mm circle. The slot in each tower is 0.2 mm larger, 2.6 mm deep.
- Two tabs hang beside each bar. 2 mm thick, 4 mm tall, 0.1 mm off the face.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.2
```

## Don't

- Don't print it tabs-down. The tabs are the part that stands off the bed.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: the cap is a 2.4 mm disc. Tabs flank the towers. Turn it over on assembly.
